verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a Marketing API whose root resource links to all other resources, plus an API call to generate and download a full account export. Campaign reports with open and click rates exist in the product, and Transactional webhooks POST per-message open/click events to your endpoint. Together these suggest engagement data can reach your own systems, but no reporting endpoint for campaign or flow metrics is actually shown. Missing for 10: a documented reports/metrics API endpoint for campaigns, automation/flow performance metrics via the API, confirmation that account exports include performance data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of warehouse or dashboard pipelines.
